title: 3ddelay
description: Estimates the time delay between each voxel time series in a 3D+time dataset and a reference time series.

reference_file.description: Input ideal time series file name
reference_file.title: Reference file

sampling_freq.description: Sampling frequency in Hz. of data time series (1/TR)
sampling_freq.title: Sampling frequency

stim_period.description: Stimulus period in seconds. Set to 0 if stimulus is not periodic
stim_period.title: Stimulus period

prefix.description: The prefix for the results Brick
prefix.title: Prefix

polort.description: Detrend input time series with polynomial of specified order. Default is -1 for auto selection
polort.title: Polynomial order

nodtrnd.description: Remove only the mean (equivalent to polort 0)
nodtrnd.title: No detrending

units_seconds.description: Units for delay estimates in seconds
units_seconds.title: Units in seconds

units_degrees.description: Units for delay estimates in degrees. Requires Tstim > 0
units_degrees.title: Units in degrees

units_radians.description: Units for delay estimates in radians. Requires Tstim > 0
units_radians.title: Units in radians

phzscale.description: Scale phase: phase -> phase*SC (default no scaling)
phzscale.title: Phase scale

bias.description: Do not correct for the bias in the estimates
bias.title: Bias correction disabled

nobias.description: Correct for the bias in the estimates (default)
nobias.title: Bias correction enabled

nodsamp.description: Do not correct for slice timing differences
nodsamp.title: Slice timing correction disabled

mask.description: Filename of mask dataset. Only voxels with non-zero values in the mask will be considered
mask.title: Mask file

nfirst.description: Number of first dataset image to use in the delay estimate
nfirst.title: First image

nlast.description: Number of last dataset image to use in the delay estimate
nlast.title: Last image

co.description: Cross Correlation Coefficient threshold value to limit ascii output
co.title: Cross Correlation Coefficient threshold

asc.description: Write the results to an ascii file for voxels with cross correlation coefficients larger than CCT
asc.title: Output ASCII file

ascts.description: Write the results and time series to an ascii file for voxels with cross correlation coefficients larger than CCT
ascts.title: Output ASCII file with time series
